names.legendary: Professor Sumsworth, Never Wrong

lore.common: Has one sticky button that adds an extra seven to every answer.
lore.uncommon: Spells HELLO when turned upside down, and the whole class giggles every single time.
lore.rare: Crunched a sum so long that the screen ran out of room and showed an E.
lore.epic: Click-clacked in every hand in the exam hall at once, and the teacher couldn't hear herself think.
lore.legendary: Has done the sums for the same shopkeeper for forty years without a single mistake.

names.legendary: Coach Pulsebeat of the Running Track

lore.common: Buzzes your wrist to tell you to stand up, just as you get comfy.
lore.uncommon: Counts arm-waving as steps, so its owner sits on the sofa waving.
lore.rare: Noticed its wearer's heart racing during a scary film and asked if they were exercising.
lore.epic: Buzzed on every wrist at the fun run at the same second, and the runners all checked at once.
lore.legendary: Counted every step of a walk across the whole country and still had battery left.

names.legendary: Lady Routewell of the Dashboard

lore.common: Says recalculating every time you take a turn it didn't suggest.
lore.uncommon: Tells you to turn left into a field, a river or a farmer's barn.
lore.rare: Sent a delivery van down a lane so narrow that it had to reverse for a mile.
lore.epic: Sent every car on the motorway down the same tiny village road during a jam.
lore.legendary: Guided a lost family across three countries to the right campsite without a single wrong turn.

names.legendary: Old Ohmsworth of the Toolbox

lore.common: Pokes its two probes into everything, including your sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Has a dial with twenty settings, and everyone who borrows it just leaves it on the beeping one.
lore.rare: Found the broken fuse in a whole house of tangled wires in one minute.
lore.epic: Tested every plug in the school in one afternoon, and every lamp came back on.
lore.legendary: Has found faults in a thousand machines and never once got a shock itself.

names.legendary: Old Truenorth of the Explorer's Pocket

lore.common: Spins its needle in circles every time you stand near the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Always points north, even when you'd rather go south for ice cream.
lore.rare: Wobbled its needle so much near a magnet that it pointed at the toilet.
lore.epic: Guided a whole school trip across the moor in the fog without a wrong turn.
lore.legendary: Guided an explorer across the frozen north and back, and still points north today.

names.legendary: Little Northstar of the Rucksack

lore.common: Hides in the bottom of your rucksack just when you need it.
lore.uncommon: Hangs on your keyring and points north every time you check the time.
lore.rare: Found the way out of the foggy woods when the grown-ups were lost.
lore.epic: Guided every scout at camp round the orienteering course in record time.
lore.legendary: Was carried up every mountain in the country on the same keyring.

names.legendary: Old Hourglass of the Kitchen Shelf

lore.common: Runs out of sand just as you turn your back on the boiling pan.
lore.uncommon: Has to be turned upside down at exactly the right moment.
lore.rare: Timed a soft-boiled egg so perfectly that the yolk was runny every time.
lore.epic: Timed every egg in the café on the busiest breakfast morning without missing one.
lore.legendary: Has timed a hundred thousand perfect eggs and still has every grain of sand.

names.legendary: Lady Dingwell of the Oven Door

lore.common: Ticks so loudly on the counter that you can hear it from the garden.
lore.uncommon: Dings so suddenly that everyone in the kitchen jumps.
lore.rare: Was twisted round so far that it rang in the middle of the night.
lore.epic: Counted down every cake at the bake sale, and not a single one was burnt.
lore.legendary: Has timed every Sunday roast for forty years and never let one burn.

names.legendary: Captain Lodestone of the Old Ship

lore.common: Swings its needle so wildly in a storm that the sailors feel seasick looking at it.
lore.uncommon: Sits in a brass case on the ship's deck and shines in the sun.
lore.rare: Held its heading steady through the worst storm of the voyage.
lore.epic: Guided a whole fleet across the ocean without a single ship getting lost.
lore.legendary: Has guided ships across every ocean for two hundred years and still points true.

names.legendary: Sir Tickington of the Waistcoat

lore.common: Flips its lid open at the wrong moment and catches on your jumper.
lore.uncommon: Ticks so loudly in its owner's pocket that the cat follows him around.
lore.rare: Made its owner late for everything by running five minutes slow.
lore.epic: Was checked by every passenger at the station when the train was late, and they all said tut.
lore.legendary: Has kept perfect time for a hundred years in three generations of waistcoat pockets.

names.legendary: Lord Fobsworth of the Gold Chain

lore.common: Loops across the waistcoat and catches on every door handle.
lore.uncommon: Tangles round the buttons every time you sit down.
lore.rare: Swung its fob so grandly that it hypnotised the dinner guests.
lore.epic: Got hooked on a coat rail at the station, and pulled a whole row of coats onto the platform.
lore.legendary: Has hung from the same family's waistcoats for a hundred and fifty years.

names.legendary: Coach Splitsecond of the Track

lore.common: Starts by accident in your pocket and runs all day.
lore.uncommon: Has a lap button that its owner forgets every race, so second place is always a guess.
lore.rare: Was reset at the exact moment someone broke the school record.
lore.epic: Timed every race at sports day, and nobody argued about who won.
lore.legendary: Timed the fastest runner in the county's history, and is now kept in a glass case.

names.legendary: Old Lapcounter of the Pool Deck

lore.common: Swings round its lanyard and hits the coach on the chin.
lore.uncommon: Is always next to the whistle, and gets blown into by mistake.
lore.rare: Timed every swimmer's split down to the hundredth of a second.
lore.epic: Timed every race at the swimming gala and still had battery for the relay.
lore.legendary: Has timed every race at the same pool for thirty years and still reads perfectly.

names.legendary: Lady Countdowna of the Kitchen

lore.common: Beeps so loudly when it reaches zero that everyone drops what they're holding.
lore.uncommon: Has three buttons, and everyone presses the wrong one.
lore.rare: Was used as a chess clock, and both players ran out of time.
lore.epic: Counted down every round of the cooking show, and every chef finished with one second to spare.
lore.legendary: Has timed every round of the school quiz for twenty years and never let a team cheat.

names.legendary: Grand Towerina of the Study

lore.common: Starts an update just as you need to print your homework.
lore.uncommon: Whirrs its fan so loudly that it sounds like it's taking off.
lore.rare: Filled the screen with pop-up windows until you couldn't see the desktop.
lore.epic: Froze at the same moment as every computer in the office, and everyone went for a cup of tea.
lore.legendary: Has run every family's homework, holiday photos and games for fifteen years without breaking down.

names.legendary: Grand Servatrix of the Cold Room

lore.common: Hums all day and all night in a room nobody ever visits.
lore.uncommon: Has rows of blinking lights that look like it's thinking very hard.
lore.rare: Has never once been switched off, not even for a nap.
lore.epic: Handled every video in the country on the night of the big final, and didn't even sweat.
lore.legendary: Has stored every holiday photo in the town for twenty years and never lost a single one.

names.legendary: Old Rackmount of the Basement

lore.common: Has so many cables behind it that nobody dares pull one out.
lore.uncommon: Stacks one server on top of another until it's taller than a person.
lore.rare: Is kept in a room so cold that the engineers wear winter coats in summer.
lore.epic: Blinked every light at once during the storm, and the engineers ran in with torches.
lore.legendary: Has kept the whole town's internet running from the same basement for thirty years.

names.legendary: Lady Renderwell of the Design Studio

lore.common: Takes up the whole desk with its two screens and its giant keyboard.
lore.uncommon: Hogs every bit of power while it draws a single 3D teapot.
lore.rare: Got so hot during a render that its owner warmed their hands on it.
lore.epic: Rendered a whole animated film in one night with every computer in the studio.
lore.legendary: Designed a bridge so beautiful that the town named it after its owner.

names.legendary: Grandma Bellwether of the Hallway

lore.common: Gets its curly cord tangled every time someone walks across the hall.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to dial, one clicking turn at a time.
lore.rare: Rang so loudly at midnight that the whole house woke up for a wrong number.
lore.epic: Rang in every house in the village at the same moment when the school called about snow.
lore.legendary: Has sat on the same hall table for fifty years and taken every important call the family ever had.

names.legendary: Old Whirlington of the Ceiling

lore.common: Wobbles so much on its highest speed that everyone below ducks.
lore.uncommon: Collects a thick line of dust on every blade.
lore.rare: Has a pull cord for the light and one for the fan, and you always pull the wrong one.
lore.epic: Whirled so fast on the hottest night that every paper in the house blew off the tables.
lore.legendary: Has spun over the same dinner table for fifty years and cooled a thousand family dinners.

names.legendary: Old Ventilus of the Bathroom Wall

lore.common: Rattles in the wall for ten minutes after you switch the light off.
lore.uncommon: Sucks the steam out of the bathroom and leaves the mirror clear.
lore.rare: Pulled the smell of fried fish out of the kitchen before the guests arrived.
lore.epic: Cleared the steam from every bathroom in the hotel on the busiest morning.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same bathroom free of steam for forty years and never let the mirror fog.

names.legendary: Old Toastington of the Study

lore.common: Blows hot air straight at your toes until they tingle.
lore.uncommon: Ticks and clicks as it warms up, like it's thinking about something.
lore.rare: Warmed a whole cold room in five minutes, and the cat moved in front of it forever.
lore.epic: Warmed every chilly desk in the office on the coldest Monday of the year.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same grandad's study warm every winter for thirty years.

names.legendary: Lady Coolbreeze of the Bedroom

lore.common: Swivels back and forth so you only get a breeze half the time.
lore.uncommon: Flaps every piece of paper on your desk onto the floor.
lore.rare: Is so tall and thin that it fits in the tiniest corner.
lore.epic: Cooled every bedroom in the house during the heatwave, and everyone slept at last.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same family cool through ten summer heatwaves.

names.legendary: Captain Hoverhand of the Field

lore.common: Has two thumbsticks, and you always push the wrong one.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when the battery is low just as the drone is over the lake.
lore.rare: Flew a drone so high that it filmed the whole town from above.
lore.epic: Flew a hundred drones in perfect shapes over the park for the summer festival.
lore.legendary: Landed a drone on a coin from the other side of the field.

names.legendary: Old Gentlemuzzle of the Dog Show

lore.common: Is fiddled with by the dog all afternoon until it's crooked.
lore.uncommon: Stops a dog from barking at the postman, mostly.
lore.rare: Kept a very nervous dog calm through a whole visit to the vet.
lore.epic: Kept every excitable dog calm at the dog show, and the judges finished early.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same gentle dog safe and calm on every walk for twelve years.

names.legendary: Captain Airwell of the Rescue Kit

lore.common: Snaps its elastic strap against your ear when you put it on.
lore.uncommon: Drops down from the plane ceiling during the safety talk, and every child stares.
lore.rare: Helped a mountain climber breathe at the very top of the highest peak.
lore.epic: Dropped down in every row of the plane during the drill, and the passengers practised perfectly.
lore.legendary: Has helped a hundred climbers reach the top of the tallest mountains.

names.legendary: Lady Glacierlens of the Piste

lore.common: Fogs up the moment you stop at the top of the slope.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a white goggle-shaped tan on your face.
lore.rare: Has mirror lenses so shiny that the skier behind sees their own face.
lore.epic: Cut through a whiteout on the mountain so clearly that the whole ski school followed its wearer down.
lore.legendary: Has skied every mountain in the range and never once let a snowflake in.

names.legendary: Professor Spectacula of the Tech Fair

lore.common: Blinks notifications in front of your eyes while you're trying to read.
lore.uncommon: Talks to you in a tiny voice that nobody else can hear.
lore.rare: Recognised every face in the crowd and remembered everyone's name.
lore.epic: Dazzled every visitor at the tech fair, and the queue went round the block.
lore.legendary: Translated a whole conversation in a foreign market so its wearer could buy the best mangoes.

names.legendary: Old Breathtube of the Lagoon

lore.common: Gurgles water into your mouth every time a little wave comes along.
lore.uncommon: Has a mouthpiece that leaves teeth marks after every swim.
lore.rare: Dipped under the water so smoothly that the fish didn't notice it.
lore.epic: Peeked at every fish on the reef in one afternoon, and the fish started peeking back.
lore.legendary: Has explored every lagoon on the island and still has its original mouthpiece.

names.legendary: Lady Coralview of the Bay

lore.common: Fogs up after five minutes, so you see nothing but cloud.
lore.uncommon: Has a strap that tangles in your hair every time you take it off.
lore.rare: Showed its wearer a whole hidden world of fish under the jetty.
lore.epic: Explored the whole reef with a family of snorkellers, and nobody wanted to get out.
lore.legendary: Has shown a thousand children their first fish and never let in a drop.

names.legendary: Old Clearvision of the Pool

lore.common: Squashes your eyes so tightly that you look like a panda after swimming.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its strap so hard that it stings the back of your head.
lore.rare: Let its wearer count every tile on the bottom of the pool.
lore.epic: Was worn by every swimmer in the gala, and the pool sparkled with coloured lenses.
lore.legendary: Has swum ten thousand lengths and never once let in a single drop of chlorine.

names.legendary: Lady Virtua of the Other World

lore.common: Walks its wearer straight into the sofa while they think they're on a beach.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a red strap mark on your face and makes your forehead sweat.
lore.rare: Took its wearer to the bottom of the sea and the top of a volcano before lunch.
lore.epic: Had the whole family flailing round the living room at once, and the lamp didn't survive.
lore.legendary: Let a grandma who had never left her village walk round every famous city in one afternoon.

names.legendary: Madame Bouclette of the Salon

lore.common: Touches your neck by accident and makes you yelp.
lore.uncommon: Twists straight hair into bouncy ringlets in a few seconds.
lore.rare: Left a faint smell of toasted hair floating round the bathroom.
lore.epic: Curled every head at the prom party, and the room looked like a field of springs.
lore.legendary: Has curled a thousand brides' hair and never once singed a single strand.

names.legendary: Sir Buzzworth of the Bathroom Shelf

lore.common: Leaves a little patch of stubble under the nose every morning, and nobody notices until lunchtime.
lore.uncommon: Spills tiny whiskers all over the sink every single day.
lore.rare: Glided over a scratchy chin so smoothly that the cat came for a stroke.
lore.epic: Buzzed in every bathroom on the street at the same time on the first day of school.
lore.legendary: Has shaved the same grandad every morning for thirty years and never once nicked him.

names.legendary: Lady Sleekwell of the Dressing Table

lore.common: Tangles its cord round your arm every time you use it.
lore.uncommon: Flattens even the frizziest hair into a sheet of silk.
lore.rare: Sizzled a wet bit of hair so loudly that everyone thought it was frying bacon.
lore.epic: Was passed round every bedroom before the school disco, and the whole house smelled of warm hair.
lore.legendary: Straightened a famous singer's hair before every concert for ten years.

names.legendary: Coach Thumper of the Locker Room

lore.common: Thuds so loudly against your back that the neighbours hear it.
lore.uncommon: Pounds your shoulders like a tiny woodpecker.
lore.rare: Found a knot in its owner's back that had been there for three years.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole football team after the match, and the changing room sounded like a building site.
lore.legendary: Kept an entire marathon team running for a whole season without a single sore leg.

names.legendary: Old Foilsworth of the Washbag

lore.common: Has a cord so short that you have to shave bent over the sink.
lore.uncommon: Has a thin silver foil head that tickles your face.
lore.rare: Munched through a week of stubble in one pass.
lore.epic: Buzzed through the whole rugby team before the photo, and the changing room was full of whiskers.
lore.legendary: Has been carried round the world in the same washbag for twenty years.

names.legendary: Sir Callwell of the Commuter Train

lore.common: Makes its wearer look like they're talking to nobody in the supermarket.
lore.uncommon: Slips out of your ear just as you lean over a puddle.
lore.rare: Paired with the wrong phone and played next door's music in your ear.
lore.epic: Was worn by everyone on the commuter train, and the carriage sounded like a busy office.
lore.legendary: Handled a thousand calls in one week without its battery running out.

names.legendary: Agent Whisperwell of the Backstage

lore.common: Tangles its cord into a knot in your pocket.
lore.uncommon: Whispers instructions into its wearer's ear all day.
lore.rare: Gave the actor her cue at exactly the right moment, and nobody saw a thing.
lore.epic: Whispered cues to every stagehand at the big show, and every scene change was perfect.
lore.legendary: Has whispered every cue at the same theatre for twenty years and never once got one wrong.

names.legendary: Grandad's Little Helper

lore.common: Whistles when someone hugs its wearer too close.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when the battery is low, right in the middle of a story.
lore.rare: Picked up a whisper from the other side of the room that wasn't meant to be heard.
lore.epic: Turned up the volume at the family dinner, and grandad heard every joke for the first time in years.
lore.legendary: Helped grandad hear his granddaughter's first words, and he still talks about it.

names.legendary: Captain Skyeye of the Field

lore.common: Buzzes overhead like a giant wasp that won't leave the picnic.
lore.uncommon: Hops over the garden hedge to see what next door is doing.
lore.rare: Was chased round the park by every dog, and the dogs nearly won.
lore.epic: Flew a light show over the park with a hundred others, and the whole town looked up.
lore.legendary: Delivered a birthday cake across the lake without dropping a single crumb.

names.legendary: Captain Rotorbug of the Bedroom

lore.common: Bonks against the ceiling as soon as you turn it on.
lore.uncommon: Spins round in circles until the remote is pointed the right way.
lore.rare: Got caught in the curtains and hung there until dinner time.
lore.epic: Flew round every room in the house in one afternoon and scattered the cards off the table.
lore.legendary: Was flown for a hundred hours by the same child and only crashed into the cat twice.

names.legendary: Lady Powderpuff of the Mirror

lore.common: Puffs a cloud into the air that makes everyone sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Comes with a soft round pad that leaves a little circle on your nose.
lore.rare: Stopped the shine on an actor's nose under the hottest stage lights.
lore.epic: Puffed so much powder in the dressing room before the show that it looked like it had snowed.
lore.legendary: Has powdered a hundred actors' noses at the same theatre and never left a smudge.

names.legendary: Old Platterworth of the Desk Drawer

lore.common: Whirrs and clicks so loudly that it sounds like it's chewing.
lore.uncommon: Says it's full just when you want to save one more photo.
lore.rare: Held every family photo since the baby was born, all in one little box.
lore.epic: Backed up the whole school's homework in one night, and the teachers cheered.
lore.legendary: Was dropped down a flight of stairs, kept spinning, and saved a whole novel its owner had forgotten to back up.

names.legendary: Old Snapsworth of the Cellar

lore.common: Gets set in the wrong place every time, so it catches slippers, socks and the dog's nose instead of mice.
lore.uncommon: Is set with a piece of cheese that the mouse always manages to steal.
lore.rare: Caught a toe instead of a mouse, and the toe's owner hopped round the kitchen.
lore.epic: Guarded the whole pantry for a winter, and the mice moved next door.
lore.legendary: Has guarded the same cellar for fifty years, and the mice now send it postcards from the barn.

names.legendary: Old Filterworth of the Engine Bay

lore.common: Drips greasy oil on your hands every time you touch it.
lore.uncommon: Has to be spun off with a special tool that nobody can find.
lore.rare: Caught so much dirt in the engine oil that the engine purred like new.
lore.epic: Was changed on every car in the garage on the same busy Saturday.
lore.legendary: Kept the same old tractor's engine clean for ten years of hard work.

names.legendary: Old Bladewell of the Pencil Pot

lore.common: Snaps the lead every time you sharpen your best pencil.
lore.uncommon: Spills curly shavings all over the desk when you open it.
lore.rare: Sharpened a pencil to a point so fine that it could write on a grain of rice.
lore.epic: Sharpened every pencil in the school before exams, and the classroom smelled like a forest.
lore.legendary: Has sharpened a mountain of pencils and still has its original little blade.

names.legendary: Old Rubberly of the Pencil Case

lore.common: Smudges the mistake into a grey cloud instead of rubbing it out.
lore.uncommon: Lives on the end of a pencil and gets chewed by nervous students.
lore.rare: Shed so many crumbs on the page that the desk looked like it was covered in sand.
lore.epic: Rubbed out every mistake in the whole class's maths homework, and the teacher gave everyone a gold star.
lore.legendary: Has been rubbed down to a tiny stub after correcting a whole novel.

names.legendary: Sir Clickwell of the Car Park

lore.common: Unlocks the car by accident when you sit on it.
lore.uncommon: Clicks the car locked three times because you keep checking.
lore.rare: Found the car in a huge car park by making it flash its lights.
lore.epic: Beeped every car in the car park at once when the battery went funny, and the whole car park flashed.
lore.legendary: Has opened the same car every morning for fifteen years and never needed a new battery.

names.legendary: Old Swipeworth of the Front Desk

lore.common: Beeps at the door and flashes red, so you have to try three times.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in your pocket among all the other keys.
lore.rare: Opened every door in the building, even the one with the snacks in.
lore.epic: Was swiped by every worker at once on Monday morning, and the doors couldn't keep up.
lore.legendary: Has opened the same office door ten thousand times and never once been refused.

names.legendary: Old Jangleworth of the Hall Hook

lore.common: Jangles so loudly in your pocket that you can never sneak in late.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its clip open and drops all your keys down a drain.
lore.rare: Holds so many trinkets that it's heavier than the keys.
lore.epic: Was dropped on the bus and jangled all the way down the aisle.
lore.legendary: Has held the same family's keys for thirty years, and every key still works.

names.legendary: Old Turnwell of the Bike Shed

lore.common: Is so tiny that it slips through the floorboards.
lore.uncommon: Is always lost just when the bike needs unlocking.
lore.rare: Opened a padlock that had been rusted shut for years.
lore.epic: Was lost by every student at the gym lockers on the same day, and the caretaker had a busy morning.
lore.legendary: Has opened the same bike lock every school day for ten years.

names.legendary: Little Byteworth of the Pencil Case

lore.common: Never goes in the right way round on the first try.
lore.uncommon: Loses its little cap the first day you own it.
lore.rare: Carried every file for the school project and saved the day when the internet went down.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole class to hand in homework, and every computer got the same file.
lore.legendary: Has carried every school project for one family for ten years and never lost a single file.

names.legendary: Grand Keysworth of the Office

lore.common: Collects crumbs from every lunch eaten at the desk.
lore.uncommon: Has one sticky key that types its letter twice.
lore.rare: Turned on caps lock so the whole email sounded like shouting.
lore.epic: Was typed on so fast at the deadline that the office sounded like rain.
lore.legendary: Has typed a whole series of famous novels and still has every letter on its keys.

names.legendary: Little Lessonbook of the Trolley

lore.common: Gets carried round school in a trolley and is always the one with a sticky key.
lore.uncommon: Saves everything to the cloud, so nobody can say the dog ate their homework.
lore.rare: Snapped its lid shut on a ruler and refused to open again until lunch.
lore.epic: Logged in on every desk in the school at once on Monday morning, and the wifi took a deep breath.
lore.legendary: Has helped three classes learn to type and still boots up in ten seconds.

names.legendary: Little Netsworth of the Backpack

lore.common: Has a screen so small that you squint to read anything.
lore.uncommon: Has keys so tiny that grown-ups type every word wrong.
lore.rare: Fitted into a handbag and did a whole day's work in a café.
lore.epic: Typed a whole report on a train journey across the country.
lore.legendary: Has written a whole novel in cafés and is still going strong at ten years old.

names.legendary: Lord Clickington of the Mouse Mat

lore.common: Yanks its wire off the desk every time you move it too far.
lore.uncommon: Double-clicks when you only meant to click once.
lore.rare: Surfed across the desk so fast that it fell off the edge.
lore.epic: Clicked through a thousand pages of homework in one evening.
lore.legendary: Has clicked a hundred million times and still glides across the mat as smoothly as the day it was unboxed.

names.legendary: Lady Ringwell of the Base Station

lore.common: Hides down the side of the sofa just when it starts ringing.
lore.uncommon: Is never fully charged because it's never put back on its base.
lore.rare: Was taken into the garden for a call and left in the flower bed for a week.
lore.epic: Rang while lost somewhere in the house, and the whole family searched every room.
lore.legendary: Has answered every call for the same family for fifteen years and only been lost twice.

names.legendary: Old Flipwell of the Drawer

lore.common: Snaps shut at the end of every call so loudly that everyone knows you've hung up.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to text because every letter needs three button presses.
lore.rare: Has a little aerial that you pull out for a better signal.
lore.epic: Was snapped shut by every person at the reunion when someone said remember these.
lore.legendary: Has lasted a whole week on one charge, every week, for fifteen years.

names.legendary: Doctor Beepwell of the Night Shift

lore.common: Buzzes on your belt at the worst possible moment.
lore.uncommon: Shows only a number, so you have to guess who wants you.
lore.rare: Sent its owner running down the corridor to the nearest phone.
lore.epic: Buzzed every doctor in the hospital at the same time, and the corridor became a race.
lore.legendary: Called a doctor to a hundred emergencies in one year and never once missed a beep.

names.legendary: Captain Farline of the Frozen North

lore.common: Has an antenna so big that it pokes people in the eye.
lore.uncommon: Only works when pointed at exactly the right bit of sky.
lore.rare: Called home from the middle of the ocean with a crystal-clear line.
